changes.title: Fixes
notes: Gear Dye Exporting: Fixed incorrect slots 2 and 3.
Removed Static Map viewing. Marathon maps are too large/resource heavy to be viewed here.

changes.title: Additions
notes: Added Sound Bank viewing. Some entries are named (if the wordlist is present) though there is a chance that a name can be incorrect/inaccurate. Entries are sorted by named first then unnamed.

changes.title: Fixes
notes: Hopefully fixed a random crash when exporting cubemap textures.

changes.title: Exporting
notes: Gear View: When adding a weapon to the export list, supported attachments can now be selected to export instead of it's default attachments.
Gear View: Stickers can now be exported, they are (usually) just a single texture or 2.
Gear View: When exporting a weapon, a DyeColor.txt file (WIP) is created that includes the weapons dye colors to use on attachments.

changes.title: Fixes
notes: Various fixes from the Server Slam to Release.

changes.title: Additions
notes: Weapon Audio can now be viewed and exported.
[Experimental] DX12 shaders can now be decompiled into HLSL, though its not very user friendly.

changes.title: Exporting
notes:
Gear exports now include their "UI" model and "World" model.
These include things such as Patch Kits where the model used when you heal is an injector vs a different model in the inventory.
Weapons will now import into Blender with their default attachments in their correct positions.

changes.title: Hello :)
notes: Welcome to the MIDA Beta, please report any issues you find in the Marathon Model Ripping Discord server!
